title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Captain 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Captain Tobacco is a bold and complex blend designed for those who enjoy the deep, full-bodied taste of traditional Tobacco with an exotic twist. Earthy Tobacco notes are enriched with nutty undertones, while the sweet warmth of Raisin Rum and a creamy Vanilla base add layers of richness. The result is a sophisticated and satisfying vape with a smooth, well-rounded finish. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Captain Tobacco is crafted to replicate the deep, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting depth of flavour while delivering a consistently smooth and enjoyable vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
